subject: Recap & Next Steps: Logi.ai discovery -> pilot kickoff plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Bowman <abowman@logi.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: discovery call + proposed pilot scope (quick summary)

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before we lock schedules.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: high latency and cost variability on current NER and document-routing models when load peaks (particularly EOD batch windows).
- Goal: reduce inference cost per 1k requests by ~40% while keeping F1 drop <2 points on named-entity extraction; p95 latency target <= 250ms for the 95th percentile of production traffic.

Proposed pilot (high level)
1) Scope: 30-day POC running on a 2-GPU dedicated Redwood instance against a sampled subset (10%) of your production traffic; evaluate both batching and prefix/KV caching improvements.
2) Success metrics: baseline vs pilot for cost per 1k reqs, p50/p95 latency, throughput (reqs/sec), and NER F1 on the validation prompt set.
3) Deliverables: weekly telemetry dashboard, prompt/eval set (we'll start with the subset attached), a short playbook for model rollbacks and fallback routing.

Owners & asks (first pass)
- Redwood: Ben (technical lead) will run model tuning and runtime config; Tessa (PM) will coordinate timelines and reporting.
- Logi.ai: Alex (product) and Priya (infrastructure) to provide access to a staging stream and the validated prompt set; we need an infra contact for VPC peering and an allowlist for IPs.

Immediate next steps (this week)
- Alex: confirm staging stream access and an infra contact for peering (by Thu).
- Ben: draft pilot runbook + access matrix (ETA Fri).
- Tessa: schedule kickoff working session (30–45m) for next week and upload baseline metrics template.

Attachments: pilot_scope_v1.pdf (outline), prompt-set-preview.md (sample prompts), access_matrix.xlsx (info we need).

If anything above is off, correct me and I'll update the doc. If this looks good I'll put the kickoff working session on the calendar for next Tue.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

attachment: pilot_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)
attachment: prompt-set-preview.md (text)
attachment: access_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alex Bowman <abowman@logi.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@logi.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery call + proposed pilot scope (quick summary)

Thanks Tessa — clear and helpful. A few clarifications from our side and one small ask.

Clarifications
- 10% traffic sample: we can feed a replay stream from staging that approximates production peak windows (EOD spikes) — Priya will confirm retention window and format.
- Target F1 drop: happy with <=2 points; we will provide the current evaluation harness and baseline metrics by tomorrow.

Ask
- For the peering/IP allowlist we need an initial list of IP ranges from you so our security team can pre-approve. Can you share the short list?

We are OK to proceed with a 30-day pilot; please go ahead and schedule the kickoff session. For the meeting invite, Priya prefers a 10:00–11:00 PT slot on Tue/Wed next week.

—Alex
Head of Product, Logi.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Bowman <abowman@logi.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-08T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runbook + ask: minimal IAM + sample dataset access

Alex/Priya — attaching the draft runbook and the access matrix we need to start. High level items I want to call out:

Pilot config (technical)
- Instance: 2x A100 equivalent (dedicated)
- Runtime: Redwood v2.3 inference runtime (we'll enable dynamic KV caching)
- Baseline models: your current NER model (we'll run it side-by-side with optimized variant)

Data & access
- Staging replay stream (10% sample) in JSON-lines with metadata fields: request_id, timestamp, prompt, label_file ref.
- IAM: service account with read-only access to the staging bucket + ability to write telemetry to the pilot bucket. We cannot proceed without a minimal service account and an allowlist entry.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0: baseline snapshot + smoke run (sanity checks).
- Weeks 1–3: iterative tuning and telemetry review; weekly checkpoints.
- Week 4: final evaluation and handoff doc (rollout recommendations).

Action items
- Priya: create the service account and provide the JSON key or OIDC role info (we prefer OIDC) and confirm peering contact (by EOD Thu).
- Alex: send baseline metrics and a short sample of the replay stream (<= 5000 events) for our smoke run (by Thu).
- Tessa: please confirm the kickoff time and invite list; I put a tentative agenda in the runbook.

Attachments: pilot_runbook_draft.pdf, access_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

- Service account: created and IAM role scoped to staging-bucket-read + telemetry-write; attaching the principal (we'll share via secure channel).
- Peering contact: sending you a short intro to our infra lead (mike.kim@logi.ai) in a separate email.
- Sample stream: uploaded a 3,200-event replay (s3://logi-staging/replays/2027-04-07-sample.jsonl) — Ben, you should have read access once the service principal is shared.
- Kickoff timing: Tue 2027-04-13 at 10:30 PT works for our team. Please send an invite.

Looking forward to the kickoff; we'll also attach our baseline metrics file in the HubSpot record for reference.

—Priya
